observations: Photo 0 shows a complete engine and transmission assembly lying on a metal surface, with visible hoses, belts, and metal components. The engine block and transmission are connected, suggesting a full powertrain unit.

Photo 1 shows the same unit from a different angle, with more of the engine block visible. There is rust on some parts, especially on the exhaust manifold and intake manifold. The transmission is attached at the rear.

Photo 2 is a closer side view of the same unit, showing the transmission and engine block. The transmission casing appears to be in decent condition, but there is visible wear and grime on the engine components.
No visible branding or model tags are readable on the engine or transmission in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Lexus GX 2026 engine and automatic transmission gearbox 4wd'.
The photos show a used, possibly salvaged, powertrain unit in a workshop or yard setting.
